name: Harrington's Bar & Grill

access.summary: N Judah to Embarcadero, then a short walk
access.detail: Take the N Judah inbound from 21st Ave & Judah to Embarcadero Station, then walk about two blocks to 245 Front Street between California and Sacramento. About 35 minutes end to end.

source.label: Official Harrington's Bar & Grill site
source.quote: 245 Front Street San Francisco, SF 94103 — Hours: MON - FRI: 10am -12am. CLOSED SATURDAYS & SUNDAYS. Since 1935.

flags: Weekend-closed: this Financial District pub is open Monday through Friday only, so Friday is the sole qualifying night — Saturday and Sunday are closed.
Irregularity for review: the official site's footer lists the ZIP as 94103, but 245 Front Street is in ZIP 94111. The record uses 94111; the venue's own page has the typo.
Note: the previously-tried domain harringtonsbarandgrill.com is hijacked and redirects to a gambling site. harringtonssf.com is the live official site.

verification.method: Official venue site checked on 2026-09-06 for address and hours. Hours and the weekend closure are explicit; the ZIP discrepancy on the venue's own page is flagged rather than silently corrected.
